skills.name: Reads numerals
skills.description: Sees a written numeral and knows which quantity it stands for.

skills.name: Counts one by one
skills.description: Pairs each object with exactly one count, without skipping or double counting.

skills.name: Knows how many
skills.description: Understands that the last number counted is the size of the set, and stops there.

skills.name: Uses quantity in new situations
skills.description: Makes the right amount with unfamiliar numbers, different objects, and when no numeral is shown.

skills.name: Compares two amounts
skills.description: Tells which of two sets has more, fewer, or the same.

skills.name: Puts two amounts together
skills.description: Joins two sets and finds how many there are altogether.
